name: Jack R. Reiter
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Miami, Florida
education: University of Florida Levin College of Law
about: Jack R. Reiter is an attorney providing legal services covering Appellate, Insurance Coverage and Business Litigation.

Jack Reiter, who practices law in Miami, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Florida Levin College of Law. He graduated in 1994. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1994.
